_about: The public app (ages 2-7). Which question folders in source/ go into which level. A folder is '<prefix> <number>' (e.g. 'math 4'): one picture (.jpg/.png) and three voice clips ending in a.mp3 (question), b.mp3 (correct), c.mp3 (wrong). The folder number is the question's # in the quiz .md file and in the set's recording script (the owner's .txt: its wording, choices and answer win over the .md table) unless the set's numbers map says otherwise, e.g. numbers {3: 11} = folder 'science 3' is quiz question #11. A folder holding 'standin.txt' has stand-in voice clips (tools/standin_voice), shown as such in the credits until Momo's own clips replace them. Every level: a missed question comes back once at the end of the round. Run: .venv/bin/python -I tools/build_content.py
